outputs.summary: Implemented GitHub Issue #7 sub-task 1: YAML workspace definition schema, loader, validator, and CLI validate command. Added js-yaml dependency. Created 4 new source files (types/definition.ts, definition/loader.ts, definition/validator.ts, definition/index.ts), modified 2 existing files (types/index.ts for DEFINITION_ERROR code, cli/index.ts for validate command), and created 2 fixture files. All typecheck, build, and smoke tests pass. Functional testing confirmed correct behavior for valid, invalid, and missing-file scenarios.

summary: Implemented YAML workspace definition support: created TypeScript interfaces (WorkspaceDefinition, WorkspaceDefinitionMetadata, WorkspaceDefinitionSpec), YAML loader using js-yaml with DefinitionError, validator returning all errors at once, re-export index module, and CLI validate --definition command with human and JSON output. npm run check (typecheck + build + smoke test) passes. Functional tests confirm valid definitions pass, invalid definitions list all errors, and missing files are handled gracefully.
